canonical_release.usd_folder_policy: Keep the complete usd/right folder together; the layered asset is self-contained only as a folder.

legacy_dataset_compatibility.joint_mapping: Map the same 20 semantic joint values by joint name, never by raw imported index.
legacy_dataset_compatibility.warning: Legacy labels were optimized and collision-filtered against the legacy geometry. Coordinate conversion preserves kinematics, but official collision geometry still requires a new collision preflight and physical validation.

runtime_policy.new_offline_fk_and_training_geometry_tar: official companion URDF from the same commit
runtime_policy.existing_dataset_status: Immutable compatibility input generated with the legacy r_base_link model and collision SDF; do not relabel it as official geometry without regenerating collision labels and physical validation.
runtime_policy.native_usd_baseline: Do not overwrite official joint drives, effort limits, self-collision or collision approximation in the first A/B test.
runtime_policy.physical_materials: The official hand USD has no authored physics material; friction and restitution must be declared and logged by the experiment.
